stories.title: PM sets wheat support price at Rs4,500
stories.brief: Separately, National Food Security Minister Rana Tanveer Hussain has promised a better support price for wheat farmers this season, saying Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif will coordinate with the provinces to establish a uniform rate as the government seeks to stabilise the market.

stories.title: PM sets indicative wheat price at Rs4,500 per maund for 2027
stories.brief: The PMO statement added that the prime minister’s decision was aimed at “promoting agriculture sector in the country, protecting farmers’ economic interests and increasing wheat production next year”.

stories.title: Regional powers back Islamabad MoU
stories.brief: Pakistan, Türkiye, Saudi Arabia and Egypt on Friday threw their collective weight behind the Islamabad-brokered understanding between Iran and the United States, as regional and European powers stepped up diplomatic efforts to prevent another round of hostilities in the Gulf.

stories.title: Sana urges Achakzai to seize talks initiative
